testFuzz_cancelThenRecomplete(uint16,uin.notice: Property: a request → cancel → request → complete cycle leaves the stone in a fully consistent state for any valid parent weight.

testFuzz_childWeightsRespectParent(uint1.notice: Property: children weights may sum to AT MOST the parent weight. The tx succeeds iff sum(w) <= parentWeight, and reverts otherwise — no in-between state is ever reachable.

testFuzz_deepLineageTree(uint16,uint8,ui.notice: Property: a multi-generation tree built with random splits keeps every lineage link intact. From ANY random leaf we can walk parentTokenId all the way back to the genesis stone, every hop is recorded in the parent's children[] list, and weights never increase when going up the chain.

testFuzz_exactSplitConservesWeight(uint1.notice: Property: cutting a stone with a random k-way split conserves weight — the child weights sum EXACTLY to the parent weight, so no weight is created or destroyed inside the valid range.

testFuzz_genesisSequentialIds(uint8,uint.notice: Property: every genesis mint with weight > 0 and non-empty URI succeeds, token ids are strictly sequential, and the stone is owned by the minter.

testFuzz_onlyLabCanMint(address).notice: Property: only an account holding LAB_ROLE can mint. Any other account (including the admin and random addresses) must revert.
